active_continuity: Taekyung is publicly recognized as Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple and heir to the Fire Gate Clan’s orthodox lineage.

Taekyung completed the Manifestation of Qi Achievement, unlocked Spear Energy and Unaffected by a Hundred Poisons, defeated and killed the Level 115 Named Monster Carus, and perfectly cleared The Black Wyvern’s Nest.
Taekyung is an A-Rank Hunter and nationally famous as the Tollgate Hero; media intrusion exposed his family’s personal information.
Jin Mukyung remains secluded in the training hall and has not returned to Heaven’s Gate Temple.
The Jin Family received an invitation to the Star-Array Grand Banquet in Henan.
Seong Jinho is staying at Taekyung’s new family home after losing his housing deposit to Kim Jong-su.
Won Myunghoon was the former Star Guild CEO and a thirty-nine-year-old A-Rank Hunter; Taekyung killed him after Won led an ambush, surrendered, and attempted another attack.
The joint Peace Guild-Star Guild raid was redirected to The Black Wyvern’s Nest; Won killed the Green Wyvern alone, Taekyung received no EXP, and Won lent him Yeti’s Necklace.
Taekyung killed forty-seven B-Rank Orc Warriors alone, and Im Kkeokjeong was among survivors he had rescued during an earlier E-Rank Gate attack.
Mutated Gates can contain monsters far above their expected Grade; Song Song rejected Taekyung’s confession but accepted friendship and a guildmate relationship.
The Peace Guild witnessed Taekyung kill Carus and now understands that his previously observed abilities represented only a fraction of his strength.
Carus’s corpse was more than fifty meters long and difficult to process; Taekyung feared using the Inventory to remove it because reporters were stationed at the Gate entrance.
The exit Gate opened unexpectedly after Won’s death and released around a dozen people before waiting reporters.
Butler Kim is an A-Rank mage who incapacitated veteran B-Rank Star Guild Hunters with Earthquake; Kim Jonghun was bound as bait before being found gagged and tied to a tree.
Taekyung publicly disclosed the Named Monster and Mutated Gate, reported eight total deaths including Won, and described Won’s death as having been disposed of.
Kim Jonghun later confessed fully, while an anonymous USB and note supplied concealed raid footage that exposed Won’s conduct and triggered intense public backlash.

The investigation into Won uncovered numerous additional crimes, systematic cover-ups, and corruption involving political and business figures; the prosecutor predicts that at least half will lose their positions.
Carus’s processed remains have a Christie’s-assessed auction starting price of 300 billion won, pending Taekyung’s consent to the sale.
The Peace Guild members agreed that Taekyung will receive the entire proceeds from the proposed auction.
Taekyung realized what he wanted to do with the coming fortune and asked Team Leader Choi for an unspecified favor.
